mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing overcast skies at Reddan Soccer Park with an actual temperature of 84 degrees. Tonight, the low will reach 71 degrees with no rain predicted. If you are a night owl, the ISS will be visible tomorrow morning at 4:17 AM for 4 minutes, rising in the northwest near Verona High School and heading toward Fitchburg.

In city news, the Verona Senior Center is beginning a flooring replacement project on September 1, which will impact availability with closures through September 11, including a Labor Day closure. Also, public works crews are currently addressing a water main break near 212 Todd Street, so expect service interruptions in that immediate area.
For your calendar, Yoga at Insight Wellness is today. Tomorrow is packed with trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music and the downtown Farmer's Market are happening Tuesday.
In a noteworthy call from August 25, officers and EMS successfully saved a 68-year-old man who was not breathing by using an AED during a medical emergency on Enterprise Drive.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Turtle Dove. The store is currently open until 10 PM, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
